notes: Our own package, listed as Community because on a small local model (about 9B) it passes puffpai check Level 1, not Level 3: the bot often picks the wrong tool. Built for a model of about 30B. It asks for "as written", so a PuffPAI that does not know that setting (test 16 and older) refuses to add it. Adding it downloads Python parts from pypi.org, so the bot must be allowed online while you add it.
